title: In is_valid_header of timed_cache_item.c, there is a possible out-of-bounds write due to a missing… (CVE-2026-58977)
description: A vulnerability exists in the is_valid_header function of timed_cache_item.c due to a missing bounds check that can cause an out-of-bounds write. Exploitation requires local system execution privileges and does not require user interaction. This flaw could allow local escalation of privilege.
